mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing phenelzine levels and MAOI activity, while both drugs carry serotonergic and cardiac risks; phenelzine may also inhibit clarithromycin metabolism.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use alternative antibiotic with minimal CYP3A4 inhibition and monitor closely for serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and arrhythmias.
